welcome.title: Welcome to GrindLab!
welcome.desc: The AI coaching platform that analyzes every decision in your game, identifies your leaks, and builds a personalized study plan so you can grow as a player.

upload.title: Import your hand history
upload.desc: Export TWO files from PokerStars, GGPoker, ACR or CoinPoker: the hand history and the tournament summary. The history carries every decision; the summary carries finish place, prize, ROI and field size, and is what allows final table detection. You can drop both at once.
upload.hint: Not sure where the files are? See the export guide by site.

train.title: Train with Ghost Table & Sparring
train.desc: The Ghost Table converts your leaks into review drills with adaptive SRS, you only review what you need, when you need it. Sparring has you play your own historical hands, pausing at each decision to evaluate your choice.

ready.title: You're all set!
ready.desc: Import your first tournament for a full diagnosis, or see a sample analysis now.

exportGuide.title: How to export your hands
exportGuide.intro: Export the .txt hand history file from your site and upload it here. We detect the site automatically.

pokerstars.name: PokerStars
pokerstars.where: In the lobby: Settings > Game Play > Hand History > tick 'Save My Hand History' and click Apply. It usually saves to C:\Users\<your user>\AppData\Local\PokerStars\HandHistory\<your nick>. Not available on mobile.
pokerstars.summary: On the same screen, tick "Save My Tournament Summaries". It usually saves to C:\Users\<your user>\AppData\Local\PokerStars\TournSummary\<your nick>.

ggpoker.name: GGPoker
ggpoker.where: In the client, open PokerCraft (top menu). Pick game type, date range and stakes → Show → select the sessions → Download Hand History. Game Summaries (for the results file) are in the same place. GGPoker does not send them by email.
ggpoker.summary: In PokerCraft, Game Summaries come from the same place as the history. Download both.

acr.name: ACR / WPN
acr.where: In the client, click the settings gear (top right) → Hand Histories (left menu) → choose the destination folders for Hand Histories and Tournament Summaries → OK. For prize and ROI, also upload the results file (.ots).
acr.summary: Also tick the Tournament Summaries folder and send the .ots file. It usually sits in C:\ACR Poker\TournamentSummary\<your nick>.

coinpoker.name: CoinPoker
coinpoker.where: In the client, log in and open PokerIntel (nav menu) → EV Chart page → select the date range → click 'Download Hands' to download your hand history.
coinpoker.summary: Download the tournament summary on the same screen too, if your client offers it.

exportGuide.note: You can upload multiple files at once. The same tournament is merged automatically when the site splits the hand history across files.
exportGuide.summaryWhy: The summary is a separate file from the hands, and it is where finish place, prize, ROI and field size come from. Without it the platform also cannot detect the final table, which is where ICM changes the right decision.
